GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 014.32 (4 Sept 46) DS
(SCAPIN-1174)
APO 500
4 September 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Request for Lists of British Subjects who have Applied for Japanese Nationality.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum AG 014.32 (26 Aug 46)DS (SCAPIN - 1157), subject "Request for Lists of British Subjects who have Applied for Japanese Nationality".
2. Paragraph numbered 1.e. should be amended to read: "Persons who applied for Japanese naturalization ("Kika") but whose application was refused, or never accepted, from 1 September 1939 to 7 December 1941".
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
